title: CORRECT: early return on setauthsize failure before copying tag bytes
description: kcapi_aead_set_tag returns immediately on crypto_aead_setauthsize failure, before memcpy(ctx->tag, tag, taglen) and ctx->taglen = taglen. This is correct: a failed setauthsize leaves the transform's authsize in an unknown state. Accepting the tag bytes into ctx->tag under that condition would allow a subsequent decrypt call to run aead_request_set_crypt with a taglen that does not match the transform's actual authsize, producing a silent authentication bypass. A reviewer might suggest separating the setauthsize call so tag storage is always attempted, but that is wrong for exactly this reason.
